test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following methods prevents or reduces wind erosion of soil in open areas?

options.text: Covering up open areas with tiles or cement
Using trees or large shrubs as fences for a garden
Using pots to grow vegetables at home

solution:
The correct answer is__** Using trees or large shrubs as fences for a garden**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct method that prevents or reduces wind erosion of soil in open areas is Using trees or large shrubs as fences for a garden
 
• Wind erosion occurs when strong winds blow over loose, dry soil, carrying particles away and causing the land to lose its topsoil.
